instruction: Candid action photograph, medium full shot, eye-level. Inside a karate dojo with yellow walls and red and blue floor mats, two martial artists practice close-range defense. On the left, the man in the black t-shirt with white-striped pants (R1) is seen from behind, facing right in a sparring stance. On the right, the woman in the black t-shirt and red belt (R2) faces left, holding her hands up defensively with her forearms raised to block. Bright overhead lighting casts soft shadows on the colorful mats.
